◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho

📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🛡️ Jesse met them at the door — 1 put down. Jesse is hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.

opens.openerLine: "You look handy. What did you do with your hands, before?"
"What do you make of all this? Really."
"About what you make of all this — What do you make of all this? Really. No point pretending otherwise."
"What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"I hate to ask, but tell me you've got food to spare. I'm going hungry here. I can't keep going like this."
"Where are you from — originally? Before all this."
Sari: "You. Yeah, you. What do you make of this?"
"About where you're from — Where are you from — originally? Before all this. Famous last words."
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the north treeline by the fallen oak."
"About what you're hoping for — What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing. You'd know about that."
"About the food I needed — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
"About where you're from — Where are you from — originally? Before all this."
"About the pantry run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"About the food I needed — still need hands. Are you in?"
I keep their faces in my head like photographs. If I stop looking, I might lose them.
"I'm going hungry — do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? My hands shake when I try to work."
"Did you sleep? I kept hearing things out past the treeline. You'd know about that."
"The pantry's nearly bare. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the creek bend, past the treeline."
"What's the worst thing you've done since the sky changed? I mean it."
"About the worst thing you've done — What's the worst thing you've done since the sky changed? Makes sense to me."
"Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago. Seen worse."
"About what day it is — Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago."
"About how you slept — Did you sleep? I kept hearing things out past the treeline."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the south slope below the meadow."
"About the pantry run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"About the pantry run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
I want one day where I laugh until it hurts and it's not from nerves.
"Practical view: Can I tell you something? I'm practicing what I would say if I ever saw my family again. I haven't told anyone."
"What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it? Thank you for asking."
Meera: "You. Yeah, you. What do you make of this?"
"About the food I needed — still on my mind. I keep coming back to it."
"Why do you ask? Can I tell you something? I stole medicine from the stash once and never confessed."
"Can we talk?" Mateo sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Never mind the food I needed — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"I asked Emilio about the pantry run — Emilio's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"Why do you ask? Did you leave someone behind? ...Sorry. You don't have to answer that."
"What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here?"
"I've been turning something over. What do YOU think actually happened to us?"
"What got you through the first week? The very first days."
"About what got you through the first week — What got you through the first week? The very first days."
"Can we talk?" Enzo sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about?"
"You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Mengyao?"
"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. Please — whatever this is, it's getting worse — I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. Can you do anything?"
"Can I tell you something? I've been hiding an injury. I'm ashamed and I can't stop."
"Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone? Ha."
"Look — What do you miss most? From before."
"Sure — Have you ever hurt someone? Since all this started."
"About what you miss most — What do you miss most? From before."
"Are you going to stay? With us. For real."
"I asked Emilio about the food I needed — Emilio's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"About whether you've hurt someone — Have you ever hurt someone? Since all this started. Not that it matters."
"About needing to be alone — Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone?"
"About whether you've hurt someone — Have you ever hurt someone? Since all this started."
"I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one."
The not-knowing is a splinter. I need to get it out or it'll fester.
"Can I tell you something? I have been lying about my age — I'm younger than I look."
"About what happened to my taken kin — Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all. I'm sure it'll be fine."
"About the food I needed — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here? That's the whole of it."
"Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching? Simple as that."
"Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything."

"Can I tell you something? Before the scattering, I froze when it mattered. I think about it every day."
"About the food I needed — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"Do you dream about before? Or is it all — this — now? But what do I know."
"Water's almost gone — 8 liters. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
"Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"About what you dream about — Do you dream about before? Or is it all — this — now?"
"About the food I needed — still need hands. Are you in?"
"About the food I needed — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"What's something from your old life that's actually useful here?"
"People are smiling. I forgot what that looked like."
"Can I tell you something? I saw something in the woods I'm not telling anyone about."
"Do you believe in anything? Now, I mean. After everything. It'll pass."
"Can we talk? Have you seen anyone on the roads? Anyone at all? I'm asking everyone."

"About what you believe in — Do you believe in anything? Now, I mean. After everything."

"Don't mind me. Today's just heavy."
"I don't know what to do with my hands today. Anyway."

"...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part."

"When's the last time you really laughed?"

"We're down to 3 liters of clean water. I need someone to haul water with me at first light. Two of us, half the trips. Will you come?"
"About the pantry run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"My wound needs a second pair of hands. Could you take a look?"
"Can I be honest? It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet."
"I asked Enzo about this wound — Enzo's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"Real talk — They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan."
"I'm going hungry — have you got anything to spare? Anything? I can't keep going like this."
"My cut needs a second pair of hands. Will you help me clean it?"
"About this wound — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"

lines.line: (Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
